mapper.select: SELECT s_value FROM settings WHERE s_key = #{s_key}
SELECT t_idx, t_title, t_content, DATE_FORMAT(t_created, '%Y-%m-%d') AS t_created FROM inquiry_template ORDER BY t_created DESC
SELECT l_idx, a_idx, a_name, l_action, l_detail, l_ip, DATE_FORMAT(l_created, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS l_created FROM admin_log ORDER BY l_created DESC LIMIT #{numPerPage} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (a_idx, a_name, l_action, l_detail, l_ip) VALUES (#{a_idx}, #{a_name}, #{l_action}, #{l_detail}, #{l_ip})
